en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a coastal panorama of a town viewed from the sea. Low buildings line the shoreline with a few taller chimneys or towers in the distance. In the calm water, a small rowboat carries several people. Rocks frame the foreground at the right edge. The lower part of the postcard includes printed captions in Greek, English ("Patras"), and French ("Côte australe"), along with handwritten text and postal cancellation marks dated 1903.
